    have h₁ : -(1 / 2) ≤ x := by linarith
    have h₂ : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hx

        norm_num
      contradiction
    have h₃ : x < 45 / 8 := by
      have hkey : Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have hsub : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x := by linarith
      have ht_ge_zero : Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      -- substitute t = sqrt(1+2x)
      have h₁_sub : 4 * x ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by

        have hx_expr : x = ((Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 - 1) / 2 := by
          nlinarith
        rw [hx_expr]
        ring_nf

        <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x)]
      have h_pos_denom : (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 > 0 := by

          have : (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [h0]; ring
          contradiction
        exact pow_ne_zero _ hne |>.ne' |>.mul_self_pos
      have h_ineq_sub : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by
        have hfracs : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := hineq
        have hfrac_eq : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 := by
          rw [h₁_sub]
          field_simp [hpos_denom]
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [hfrac_eq] at hfracs
        exact hfracs
      have h2x_expr : 2 * x = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 - 1 := by
        have h_sqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * x := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        nlinarith
      rw [h2x_expr] at h_ineq_sub
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x)]
    exact ⟨h₁, h₃, h₂⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₃, h₂⟩
    have hdom_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x := by linarith
    have hdenom : (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      have h_sqrt_pos : Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have h₀_ne_one : Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) ≠ 1 := by
        intro h1
        have h_x_eq_zero : x = 0 := by
          have h_sq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [h1]
          nlinarith
        contradiction
      have h_neq : 1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply h₀_ne_one; linarith
      exact pow_ne_zero _ h_neq
    have h_pos_denom : 0 < (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by
      have hne : 1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have : Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) = 1 := by linarith
        have : x = 0 := by
          have h_sq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [this]
          nlinarith
        contradiction
      exact pow_pos (by linarith) 2
    have ht_pos : Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h_sub_ineq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 < (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 + 8 := by
      have h2x : 2 * x = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 - 1 := by
        have h_sqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * x := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        nlinarith
      have hx_upper : x < 45 / 8 := h₃
      have h_left_val : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by sorry
      have h₁_sub : 4 * x ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by
        have h_sqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * x := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
        have hx_expr : x = ((Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 - 1) / 2 := by
          nlinarith
        rw [hx_expr]
        ring_nf
        <;> field_simp <;> ring_nf
        <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x)]
      have hfrac_eq : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₁_sub]
        field_simp [h_pos_denom.ne']
        <;> ring_nf
      -- We need to show the main inequality holds
      have h_main : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 < (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 + 8 := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x)]
      have h_rhs_pos : 2 * x + 9 > 0 := by
        have h_lb : -(1 / 2) ≤ x := h₁
        nlinarith
      have h_target : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by
        have h₁_sub' : 4 * x ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by
          have h_sqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * x := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
          have hx_expr : x = ((Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 - 1) / 2 := by nlinarith
          rw [hx_expr]
          ring_nf
          <;> field_simp <;> ring_nf
          <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x)]
        calc
          4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2
            = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 := by
              rw [h₁_sub']
              field_simp [h_pos_denom.ne']
              <;> ring_nf
          _ < (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 + 8 := h_main
          _ = 2 * x + 9 := by
            have h_sqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * x := by
              rw [Real.sq_sqrt] <;> linarith
            rw [h_sqrt_sq]
            ring
      exact h_target
    exact ⟨hdom_nonneg, hdenom, h_target⟩
